changes.A: A distraction won't work on a man who can see out of the back of his skull, and sneaking in after hours means walking into lasers and malevolent spells for a mother who has already shown she'll spend you on her grudge. Going to Cerebrist directly makes you a third player instead of her pawn: you hear his side of what he "took," you see how he reacts to the question, and you don't sign up for either of their wars before you know what it's about. The tradeoff is that you're tipping him off, so whatever is in that opaque desk may vanish by morning... That's an expensive lesson in honesty for a villain academy, but you'll learn more about both of them from his face than from his drawers.
